scope: Data07 (Port congestion) transition from live AIS to the Anticipated Schedule-Based Congestion model (research-notes 2026-10-15 §1). Record the two input sources consumed by scripts/verification/compute-data07-anticipated-congestion.py: the one-time CruiseMapper cruise schedule read (scratch/cruise-pressure/schedules.json) and the Greek National Access Point sailing-traffic export (scratch/ais-routes/export_sailing_traffic.csv).

evidence.name: CruiseMapper Ionian port schedules (Oct-Nov 2026, one-time read)
evidence.provider: CruiseMapper (cruisemapper.com; browser-UA only, no public API)
evidence.method: GET with browser User-Agent (one-time bounded read of 7 port pages x 2 months), parsed by scratch/cruise-pressure/pull-cruise-schedules.py
evidence.authentication: none (but serves content only to browser user-agents)
evidence.schema_observation: JSON object {source, captured_at_utc, ports[]}; each port {id, name, slug, threshold, calls[]}; call {date, ship, ship_slug, arrival, departure}. 117 cruise calls total: Corfu 91, Kefalonia 18, Zakynthos 3, Igoumenitsa 3, Lefkada 2, Paxos 0, Ithaki 0.
evidence.note: Schedule = planned, not actual (arrivals drift; some calls have null arrival/departure times). PROPOSAL-grade source sample, NOT a production feed: substitute the Corfu Port Authority (OLKE) cruise-berth declaration feed for production. Igoumenitsa (mainland Epirus) is excluded from the EL62 model.

evidence.name: Greek National Access Point - sailing traffic export (Mar-Nov 2025)
evidence.provider: Greek National Access Point (open data export of domestic ferry sailings)
evidence.schema_observation: CSV columns: departureportname, vehiclecount, date, arrivalport, departureport, passengercount, routecode, routecodenames, arrivalportname. One row per ferry leg; passengercount/vehiclecount are the leg-level disembarking load at arrivalport. Dates 2025-03-17 .. 2025-11 (Mar-Nov 2025).
evidence.note: Empirical ferry baseline for the anticipated-congestion model: aggregate inbound legs by arrivalport per monitored EL62 island port, normalise by operating days (month + day-of-week averages with fallback). EL62 port codes: CFU/LFK=Corfu, PKE/SAI/FIS=Kefalonia, ZTH=Zakynthos, VSS/LEV=Lefkada, PAX=Paxos, PIS=Ithaki. Mainland gateways IGO/KYL/GPA excluded. Per-port inbound daily averages: Corfu 3558.5 pax + 1030.3 veh; Kefalonia 1475.6 + 508.2; Zakynthos 1893.9 + 578.7; Lefkada 156.1 + 42.0; Paxos 475.1 + 76.1; Ithaki 307.9 + 107.6.
